The '''Outlaw's Den''', known by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as '''Region 92-2987''', was an area located in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Location==
The Den could be reached via the Northern Chasm or the Central Chasm in the south.<ref name="TOR:NC" /><ref name="TOR:CC" /> The Outlaw's Den was a notorious lawless area. It was common for allies and enemies to attack each other in this area, regardless of affiliation.<ref name="TOR:LS">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Lawless Sands|Tatooine}}</ref><ref name="TOR:NMS">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|No Man's Sands|Tatooine}}</ref>

==History==
The Outlaw's Den was a ghost town with a history of conquest. Dozens of gangs, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate crews]], and even [[Tusken Raider/Legends|native raiders]] claimed the region over the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] but none managed to hold the lawless area for long. Some rumors said that the land was cursed, while others said that the ghosts of [[Death/Legends|murdered]] settlers roamed the wretched region and drove trespassers to violence. Even the most hardened locals and wanderers considered it an unsafe place and therefore avoided it.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Outlaw's Den}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Outlaw's Den was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears in the game as a player versus player area. The area also contains a [[Galactic Trade Network]] kiosk.<ref name="TOR:OD">{{TORcite|type=location|Outlaw's Den|Tatooine}}</ref>
